slides.heading: See a GP promptly if

caption:
Pain around your hip, but you can't tell if it's the hip or your back?

They sit close together and share muscles and nerve supply, so where it hurts doesn't always tell you where it's from. Groin pain or stiffness putting on socks often leans towards the hip. Pain that changes with bending or sitting and spreads into the buttock often involves the back. Plenty of people have a bit of both.

Numbness, leg weakness, bladder or bowel changes, fever or pain after a fall should be seen by a GP promptly.

Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio assess your hip and back together. Book online via the link in bio.
